labels.name: triage
labels.description: Needs initial maintainer review and routing.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small, safe, contributor-friendly issue with clear acceptance criteria.

labels.name: developer tooling
labels.description: Local scripts, static checks, CI helpers, or contributor workflow tooling.

labels.name: ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, branch protection, or continuous-integration behavior.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Reproducible defect in the demo, tooling, contracts, or docs.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: Feature request or improvement that still needs scope review.

labels.name: discovery
labels.description: Needs workflow evidence, user research, or design-partner validation before build.

labels.name: erp-safety
labels.description: Touches money, stock, payroll, permissions, compliance, tenant scope, or auditability.

labels.name: ai-safety
labels.description: Touches AI proposal policy, prompts, citations, model behavior, tools, or approvals.

labels.name: ai-control-plane
labels.description: Changes the isolated AI control-plane service, models, or runtime.

labels.name: industry-pack
labels.description: Changes or proposes vertical workflow behavior.

labels.name: contract
labels.description: Changes versioned OpenAPI, event schemas, or compatibility tests.

labels.name: dependency
labels.description: Changes package, image, Frappe, ERPNext, or runtime dependency pins.

labels.name: runtime
labels.description: Changes Docker images, local services, or runtime/container behavior.

labels.name: security
labels.description: Potential vulnerability, secret, private data exposure, or access-boundary issue.

labels.name: blocked-license
labels.description: Requires maintainer review of a license or contribution-policy concern.
